Question: Ass salam mu alikum... I wanted the tabir of my dreams.. just few days before i was very much in pain i was been hurted by my loved 1's, on the next day night while crying & remembering allah i slept, on the same night i saw a dream i am offering magrib prayer in Mekkah & have gone in fron to mekkah & gave bosa by kissing. .. what does dream indicate plz reply.. Answer ID: 21505 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 823/629/H=1431) If one forgives those who have hurt him with the intention of pleasing Allah and doing kindness with one's relatives, in this case one will get high ranks in jannah. You should hope for that. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
